messages:
DeployBot: [ALERT] SBOM provenance missing for artifact 'service-worker:1.14.0-rc2' (digest sha256:abc123...). Canary: eu-west-1 scheduled in 2h. Action required: quarantine/pin/hotpatch/exception. See CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4587
Mike R: pinging @Anya (sec) and @Priya L for triage. Canary is live in 2 hours, we need decision: delay, pin to previous digest, or quick hotpatch?
Anya (sec): I need evidence of origin. If we pin to a previously signed digest temporarily that's acceptable, but we require an attestation ticket and timeline. Prefer: pin + staggered carveout for EU canary only.
Priya L: Hotpatching would change the image digest and require a new release candidate; not ideal under time pressure. Pinning to previous digest keeps flow but we should re-run smoke tests. What's the QA turnaround?
Jae: Smoke + basic e2e in staging ~30-40m. Canary health checks ops runs another 10m. If we pin now we can probably re-trigger canary in ~45m.
Mike R: Ok proposed plan: 1) Apply temporary digest pin for eu-canary to sha256:prevabc122, 2) Re-run staging smoke and abort if failures, 3) Update release notes with pin and open INF ticket for provenance evidence. @Anya confirm compliance accept?
Anya (sec): Confirm. Condition: INF-3456 created with deadline 24h for signed provenance or we rollback. Document the exception in release notes and audit log.
Priya L: I'll coordinate ops. Running pin command now:
```
/deploy pin service-worker --digest=sha256:prevabc122 --env=eu-canary --reason="temp pin: missing SBOM provenance"
```
Priya L: Tagged the deploy:deploy-bot override request; ops will hold canary until smoke completes.
OncallBot: DeployBot: quarantine applied to rc2-eu-canary. Canary start blocked until 1798802800 unless manually overridden by an approver.
Jae: triggering staging smoke now, will post results in ~35m.
Mike R: Release notes snippet (internal): "temporary digest pin for eu canary (service-worker) due to missing SBOM provenance; investigation INF-3456; will rollback if evidence not provided within 24h." Please add to public release notes only if legal clears.
Anya (sec): I'll loop in Legal for public wording. For now internal note is sufficient.
Priya L: Smoke passed (staging) ✅. Ready to re-trigger canary after final ops check.
OncallBot: DeployBot: canary window re-open scheduled at 1798801500. Manual override available to approvers.
Mike R: Thanks team. Plan executed: pin applied, smoke passed, canary rescheduled. Follow-up owners: Priya (coord ops), Anya (compliance), Jae (QA), Mike (release notes & INF-3456).
Anya (sec): I'll add required evidence checklist to INF-3456 and set reminder. Marking approval :thumbsup:.
Priya L: I'll update the internal release notes and close the loop in the release thread.
Mike R: Closing this thread — call out if anything degrades in the EU canary.
